text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Billing metering alert: aggregate token delta > 15% vs baseline for 12m. Overages flagged for ~120 customers. Auto-runbook triggered: https://redwood/runbooks/billing-metering-variance :rotating_light:

Priya K: paging oncall, I'm on it. grabbing primary logs and runbook.

Sam R: i can help on counts side — standing by. any customer examples?

incident-bot: Sample affected customer IDs: cust_1287, cust_2049, cust_3321. Last successful ingest at 2026-03-15T01:02:16Z.

Elena S: quick triage — is this a late-ingest / replay problem or actual token miscount?

Priya K: initial look: downstream aggregation windows show ~30% extra tokens for many customers between 00:50-01:10 UTC. upstream raw events count doesn't match. sending query now.

Jared L: could be a duplicate-ingest loop from the new batching worker we rolled at 00:45. that worker touched chunking and dedupe.

Sam R: running a diff between raw_events.token_count and billed_tokens per-customer for the window.

Priya K: @billing-svc can you pause the metering pipeline output to billing for the current ingest shard? we want to avoid pushing bad totals.

billing-svc: pausing outbound billing writes for shard-7. write-consumers in HOLD state. will persist pending deltas for manual reconciliation.

Maya (CS): heads-up — CS already seeing some customer alerts for unexpected charges. I'd like a short message to send impacted customers once we know scope.

Elena S: found log snippet from batch-worker-03: ```WARN Duplicate key detected while flushing KV cache: request_id=7f9a1c, tokens=450``` then repeated 3x for same request_id. looks like retry path didn't honor dedupe token.

Jared L: that aligns. new retry backoff logic failed to set dedupe_id on retry path. patch incoming.

Sam R: diff query results: sample cust_1287 raw_events total_tokens = 312400, billed_tokens = 391800 for window. delta +25399 (8% absolute, but larger for some). I'll attach full table to the thread.

Priya K: good catch. plan: 1) hold writes (done), 2) hotfix batch-worker to set dedupe_id on retry, 3) recompute per-customer deltas offline, 4) run reconciliation before resuming billing writes, 5) communicate to customers.

incident-bot: Coordinator note: severity elevated to P1 due to potential overcharge risk > $2k across accounts. Pager duty escalation to ENG oncall.

Jared L: pushing hotfix to canary now. command: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/batch-worker --image=redwood/batch-worker:fix/dedupe-20260315```

Elena S: monitoring canary logs. I see dedupe_id now present on retry path in canary logs. no duplicates after one minute.

Sam R: re-run reconcile query for canary window: raw_events vs billed_tokens shows alignment. running full recompute for shard-7. ETA ~18m.

Priya K: handing off to Jared for hotfix verification. I'm going to draft customer comms with Maya.

Maya (CS): draft note: "We're investigating an internal billing calculation issue that may have temporarily overstated token usage for some customers. We have paused billing updates and are reconciling totals. We'll follow up with corrected invoices or credits if needed." happy to send after we confirm scope.

billing-svc: recompute job started at 1976543300, job_id=rec-1976543300. using snapshot before 00:45 to avoid double counting. incremental will be produced to /recon/1976543300.csv

Elena S: observed residuals dropping. current projected impact down to ~70 customers with minor deltas <5% after partial recompute. full job still running.

Jared L: hotfix promoted to prod. rollout complete across batch-worker replicas. monitoring for >5m.

Priya K: if recompute passes, plan to resume writes for shard-7 with reconciliation override flag so we only write corrected totals. any objections?

Sam R: fine with me. we should snapshot current billing ledger before resume.

Maya (CS): recommend message template for affected customers: brief summary, apology, commit to corrected billing within 24 hours, contact link.

incident-bot: Audit note: incident created inc-1976543210. Links: runbook, canary logs, recon CSV. Postmortem owner auto-assigned: Elena S.

Priya K: resume writes scheduled after recon job completes and ledger snapshot saved. estimated resume at 1976543490. will update when done.

Elena S: recon job completed: /recon/1976543300.csv. 68 customers affected, median delta 2.1%, max delta 14.7%. producing reconciliation patch.

billing-svc: applying reconciliation patch with override flag. writes resumed for shard-7. monitor billing queue.

Sam R: monitoring shows no new overage flags after resume. queued write backlog drained.

Maya (CS): sending customer comms now to impacted list with tentative remediation steps.

Priya K: closing incident to monitor in watch window. postmortem assigned to Elena S. willschedule RCA and follow-up actions: deploy greater test coverage for retry path, add metering unit-tests, add replay/dedup coverage in CI.

Elena S: notes for postmortem: root cause = retry path omitted dedupe_id when re-enqueuing batch on transient failure. Contributing factor: rollout at 00:45 lacked sufficient canary test for high-throughput replays. Remediation: hotfix + CI tests + runbook update.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Severity downgraded to P2. Please start postmortem within 48h. :white_check_mark:

Priya K: thanks team for quick turnaround.

Maya (CS): nice job. I'll attach customer replies to the PM for the postmortem.

Jared L: will follow up with a unit test PR.

Sam R: marking my tasks done here.

Elena S: created postmortem ticket PM-1976543210 and linked artifacts.
